Located in the Presque Isle County Courthouse. Applicants must pass a background check and drug screening. Wages and benefits are set by the applicable union contract. Applications are due July 31, 2026, by 4:00 p.m. Presque Isle County is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.
Apply To Presque Isle County Register of Deeds

P.O. Box 110

Notice of Hearing: Seasonal Lake Level Amendment for Grand Lake
August 10, 2026 – 1:30 p.m.
Presque Isle County Circuit Court
151 E. Huron Avenue, Rogers City, MI 49779
A petition filed on June 12, 2026 requests the establishment of seasonal lake levels for Grand Lake, allowing the lake to be lowered each fall and refilled to the current level each spring.
The Presque Isle County Circuit Court will review the petition at the above date, time, and location to receive evidence regarding seasonal lake levels for Grand Lake, located in Presque Isle Township and Krakow Township, in accordance with MCL 324.30707.
View Hearing Notice

Notice of Hearing: Lake Esau Special Assessment Hearing & Cost Review
August 10, 2026 – 6:00 p.m.
RCA Senior & Community Center
131 Superior Street
Rogers City, MI 49779
A special assessment roll and the computation of costs for the Lake Esau – Lake Level are available for public review at the Presque Isle County Clerk’s Office. These documents will also be available at the public hearing.
The hearing will review the assessment roll, cost calculations, and any objections before a confirmation decision is made. The hearing may be recessed and continued without further notice.
View Hearing Notice

Ever wondered what can be recycled and how to properly sort items? This recycling guide provides clear instructions to help you recycle more effectively. Presque Isle County Materials Management – Public Input Survey
Presque Isle County is creating a new Materials Management Plan, and we’d like your input. This EGLE‑required plan will guide how we manage waste, reduce landfill use, and expand recycling and reuse options.
Please take a moment to complete this short survey. Your feedback—on hazardous waste, food waste, recycling, and composting—helps us understand community needs and set priorities. Thank you for your input.
Access Survey

PI Conservation District
The Hunting Access Program is now available in Northern Michigan. It is a way for private landowners to treat their parcel as if it were public hunting land while being paid to do so. The program is flexible - allowing a high potential reimbursement depending on the quality of your habitat.
PI County Conservation District

Building & Zoning Now Accepts Credit Cards & ACH Payment
Submit your permits quickly and easily through our new BSA online portal.
The Building and Zoning Department is excited to offer faster, more convenient, and more secure online services, you can now submit permit applications, upload required documents, make payments, and request inspections all in one place. This upgrade is part of our ongoing effort to modernize services, reduce processing delays, and make it easier to complete your permit‑related tasks anytime, from anywhere.
Payments for All Building & Zoning Services

County Clerk
The Clerk's Office is where you can find information on CCW permits, marriage licenses, birth and death certificates, filing vital records, and marriage ceremonies, among other services.
Clerks Office
Equalization
Assure that all the local units of government in the county are assessed fairly and equitably. All property is assessed equitably according to market value.
Equalization
Veteran Affairs
Assists all veterans, widows, and dependents that need information for filing the proper forms with the Veterans Administration.
Veteran Affairs
County Airport
Publicly owned and operated by the Presque Isle County. This is a general utility airport that offers phone, restroom, wifi, weather and courtesy car.
Airport
Treasurer
The Treasurer are the custodian of all county funds and the collector of taxes. Other income is received from state and federal grants, interest income and various service and license fees.
Treasurers Office
Building & Zoning
Oversees construction, land use, and development, ensuring code compliance, issuing permits, conducting inspections, and managing zoning for safe, sustainable growth.
Building & Zoning

The governing body sets policies, manages budgets, oversees county services, and represents residents’ interests for effective local government.
